# Dakota Go SDK - LLM Context

> This file provides context for Large Language Models working with this codebase.

## Summary

Go SDK for Dakota Platform - stablecoin payments infrastructure (on-ramps, off-ramps, swaps, wallets).

## Primary Use Cases

1. On-ramp: Convert USD bank transfers to USDC/USDT
2. Off-ramp: Convert USDC/USDT to USD bank deposits
3. Swap: Exchange stablecoins across blockchain networks
4. Wallets: Create non-custodial multi-sig wallets

## Quick Start

```go
import "github.com/dakota-xyz/go-sdk/client"

c, _ := client.New(client.WithAPIKey("key"))
resp, err := client.CheckResponse(c.Raw().ListCustomersWithResponse(ctx, nil))
```

## Key Patterns

- All API methods: `c.Raw().<Method>WithResponse(ctx, params)`
- Always wrap with: `client.CheckResponse(...)`
- Resource chain: Customer → Recipient → Destination → Account
- Default environment: Sandbox (`api.platform.sandbox.dakota.xyz`)

## Important Files

- README.md: Full documentation
- AGENTS.md: Detailed API reference for AI agents
- client/client.go: Client initialization
- client/gen/openapi.yaml: OpenAPI spec (source of truth)
- client/gen/client.gen.go: Generated API methods

## Environments

- Sandbox (default): Testing, no real money
- Production: Live transactions, requires `WithEnvironment(client.EnvironmentProduction)`

## Networks

Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, Solana (mainnet and testnets)
